title: Real-source coverage audit for admitted Linear A IR hardening v1.1 against logos D5/D6

external_prior_art.D5_generic_statement: A sign-group may run across two faces OR two ruled lines of a stone vessel while the lineara lineage emits two transliteratedWords tokens.

D5_audit_protocol.purpose: Determine whether v1.1's SURFACE-only continuation relation can faithfully encode each real D5 case from the mechanically available source evidence, without inventing a face identity for a ruled-line break.
for_each_case_record: exact indices of both fixed lineage parts
all raw transliteratedWords items between the two parts
whether an explicit newline token lies between them
source fields whose field-name contains face/surface/side/line (case-insensitive), preserving their source values only as diagnostic metadata
whether any source-native field explicitly binds the two part positions to distinct physical surface identities
D5_audit_protocol.strict_rule: Do not infer SURFACE from a newline alone and do not infer LINE from absence of face metadata. If the flat source only establishes separation/newline, classify UNRESOLVED.
D5_audit_protocol.v1_1_directly_projectable_rule: Only EXPLICIT_DISTINCT_SURFACES_IN_SOURCE is directly projectable by SOURCE_CONTINUATION_ACROSS_SURFACE without adding information not carried by the source.
D5_audit_protocol.coverage_gap_rule: Any confirmed D5 case not classified EXPLICIT_DISTINCT_SURFACES_IN_SOURCE is a v1.1 coverage gap for real D5 projection.

D6_audit_protocol.purpose: Check that v1.1 can represent the real unresolved source-label/glyph identity conflict without semantic promotion.
D6_audit_protocol.label_predicate: any('*904' in word for word in transliteratedWords)
D6_audit_protocol.glyph_predicate: U+1066B LINEAR A SIGN A319 occurs in parsedInscription
direct_projection_requirements: document has at least one label-bearing transliteratedWords item
document has at least one U+1066B glyph
two distinct identity assertions are source-preservable
claim-bearing scientific view can require EXCLUDE_CONFLICTED_TOKENS

decision_rule.V1_1_COVERS_ALL_REAL_D5_D6: All four D5 cases have explicit distinct physical surface identity in source and all three D6 cases satisfy direct conflict projection requirements.
decision_rule.V1_1_D6_COVERED_D5_BOUNDARY_COVERAGE_GAP: All three D6 cases are directly representable but at least one D5 case lacks explicit distinct-surface evidence required by v1.1.
decision_rule.D6_COVERAGE_GAP: Any seeded D6 document cannot be represented under the frozen conflict-binding requirements.
decision_rule.SOURCE_CASE_MISMATCH: Any fixed external-prior-art D5/D6 source symptom is absent from the exact current source.

next_step_if_D5_gap.allowed: Freeze a new additive v1.2 hardening extension generalizing continuation to a typed physical/source boundary relation, preserving SURFACE, LINE, and unresolved SURFACE_OR_LINE rather than retroactively changing v1.1.
next_step_if_D5_gap.forbidden: Rewrite v1.1, relabel newline as surface, or destructively merge source-native groups.
